blocks.text: Condo buildings in Brownstones at Morgan Crossing

This is a named-complex page, not an area page: the Brownstones at Morgan Crossing is one brick-fronted townhome community at 15833 26 Avenue, next to the Morgan Crossing retail village in Grandview Heights, South Surrey. Morgan Crossing is not Morgan Creek, the golf-course community — a different place with its own board row, never used for this page.
Streets, schools and transit near Brownstones at Morgan Crossing condos

items.t: Morgan Crossing itself is the retail village at 24 Avenue / 160 Street in Grandview Heights.

Planning frame for the ground: the City's approved South Surrey land use plans for Grandview Heights include the Morgan Heights NCP, which designates land uses for the first urban residential neighbourhood in Grandview Heights, and the Orchard Grove NCP for the neighbourhood bounded by 26 Avenue to the north and 24 Avenue to the south.

blocks.text: Local rules that affect land buyers in Brownstones at Morgan Crossing

items.t: Zoning + OCP — Surrey: Surrey Official Community Plan Bylaw No. 21900 (adopted June 15, 2026) is the current OCP — Bylaw 18020 is never the current OCP. Surrey Zoning Bylaw No. 12000 governs zoning.

SSMUH — Surrey: the City adopted its SSMUH zoning changes on July 8, 2024 — a maximum of 3 units on lots smaller than 280 m², 4 units on lots larger than 280 m², and up to 6 units on eligible lots of at least 281 m² within 400 m of a frequent bus stop. Added SSMUH units are not subdivision and do not create new lots.
Strata block (strata lots, the complex's form as framed): A "45+" listing line is not a valid BC age bylaw.

blocks.text: Duplexes and half duplexes in Brownstones at Morgan Crossing
Local rules that affect duplexes in Brownstones at Morgan Crossing

items.t: Plan, zoning, SSMUH and suites (Surrey): The current Surrey plan is the Surrey 2050 OCP, Bylaw 21900 (adopted Jun 15, 2026) — Bylaw 18020 is replaced and is never cited as current. Zoning Bylaw 12000 governs. SSMUH in force Jul 8, 2024: A maximum of 3 units on lots smaller than 280 m², 4 units on lots larger than 280 m², and up to 6 units on eligible lots within 400 m of a frequent bus stop — duplexes are the baseline SSMUH form. A secondary suite's habitable floor area may not exceed 40% of the principal dwelling unit's habitable area — Surrey's own cap, never borrowed. Streamside setbacks sit in Part 7A of Zoning 12000 and vary by stream class — no single riparian figure is ever stated. City of Surrey property taxes are due July 2, with a 5% penalty if not paid by midnight July 2 and a further 5% penalty after September 2.

faq.q: Is the Brownstones a condo building?
faq.a: No. It is a townhome complex at 15833 26 Avenue beside the Morgan Crossing village — brick-fronted rowhouses with rooftop decks over ground-level tandem garages.

faq.q: Is the Brownstones in Morgan Creek?
faq.a: No. The complex is at 15833 26 Avenue beside Morgan Crossing, the retail village at 24 Avenue / 160 Street in Grandview Heights, and its board frame is the Grandview sub-area row (Condos & Townhomes 146 / 20 / 14% in September 2026). Morgan Creek is the separate golf-course community with its own row — do not price a Brownstones unit off it.

faq.q: What market numbers apply to the Brownstones?
faq.a: None of its own: SnapStats publishes no Brownstones row. The board context for its ground is the Grandview sub-area (Detached 66 / 9 / 14%; Condos & Townhomes 146 / 20 / 14% in September 2026) and the S Surrey White Rock community figures (attached median $700,000, 99% sale-to-list, 33 DOM) — context only, not Brownstones prices. The board does not publish sub-area medians.

faq.q: Who built the Brownstones, and when?
faq.a: The building directory and MLS listing data agree the complex was built in 2008, and MLS listing text attributes it to Adera — but no Adera developer page for this complex exists record (searched again 2026-11-01, including adera.com), so the builder attribution is corroborated at listing level only.

faq.q: What should I read before buying at the Brownstones?
faq.a: In a 2008 wood-frame complex, the depreciation report prices the roof, envelope and deck horizons.

faq.q: Can I rent out a Brownstones townhome, and can I keep a pet?
faq.a: Long-term rental-restriction bylaws have been void province-wide since November 24, 2022, so the directory's "rentals allowed w/restrictions" line cannot restrict a long-term rental; short-term rentals can still be restricted.

faq.q: What market numbers apply to Brownstones?
faq.a: None of its own: SnapStats publishes no Brownstones row.

faq.q: Is the Brownstones at Morgan Crossing in Morgan Creek?
faq.a: No. The complex is at 15833 26 Avenue beside Morgan Crossing, the retail village at 24 Avenue / 160 Street in Grandview Heights, and its board frame is the Grandview sub-area row; Morgan Creek is the separate golf-course community with its own row.

faq.q: What makes the Brownstones different from other South Surrey townhomes?
faq.a: Brick-fronted, connected rowhouse-style homes with rooftop decks — some with North Shore mountain views — on two storeys above a ground-level tandem garage, at about 1,250 to 1,700 sq ft with three or four bedrooms.
